title: Klarna names Brandon Gracey as Head of North America | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**New York, November 16, 2026 -** Klarna, the everyday finance network, has appointed Brandon Gracey as Head of North America. Brandon will lead Klarna’s commercial growth across the region, working with merchants and partners as the company’s network continues to grow.


Brandon joins Klarna from Shopify, where he led Global Enterprise Sales. Over 25 years in tech, he has held commercial leadership roles across commerce, benefits, insurance and VR, building teams that drive lasting growth.


“Brandon has spent his career building commercial teams that grow alongside their customers. This is exactly how we do things at Klarna, and I’m really excited to have him leading North America as we keep growing with merchants and partners across the region,” said David Sykes, President and Chief Commercial Officer at Klarna.


**About Klarna**
Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](https://www.klarna.com/)
